hardDelete.scope: Target device profile, its favorite flag and every history entry with matching deviceId

hardDelete.settingsBinding: Removed device invalidates pending settings target without breaking subsequent snapshots
hardDelete.errors: Report deletion/cleanup failure and refresh actual persisted list, never show false success
